बॉलीवुड में आने वाला है एक और धमाकेदार बैंक हीस्ट ड्रामा! 💥
जियो स्टूडियोज के बैनर तले बन रही इस फिल्म में नजर आएंगे जयदीप अहलावत और शेफाली शाह। 🎬
फिल्ममेकर विपुल शाह पूरे पच्चीस साल बाद आंखें जैसी फिल्म के बाद एक बार फिर ऐसा सस्पेंस लेकर आ रहे हैं। 🤩
क्या आप इस खतरनाक बैंक हीस्ट को देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? 👇

ctx.title: REVEALED: Jio Studios backs Jaideep Ahlawat-Shefali Shah starrer Hisaab; 25 years after Aankhen, Vipul Shah promises a NEVER-BEFORE-SEEN bank heist drama in Indian cinema
ctx.summary: Vipul Shah made a smashing directorial debut in Bollywood with Aankhen (2002) and followed it up with films like Waqt: The Race Against Time (2005), Namastey London (2007), London Dreams (2009), Action Replayy (2010) and Namaste England (2018). He subsequently ventured into the digital space, as a director, with the web series Human and Commando. Now, he's all set to return to feature film direction after a gap of nine years with Hisaab, which is slated to release in 2027. The film stars Jaideep Ahlawat and Shefali Shah in the lead and Bollywood Hungama has learned that Jio Studios is also associated with the much-awaited heist drama. As per the website of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC), Hisaab was passed with a U/A 13+ certificate last year. Interestingly, Vipul Shah's Sunshine Pictures Ltd and Jio Studios are both mentioned as producers of the film. Besides Shefali Shah and Jaideep Ahlawat, Hisaab also boasts an interesting ensemble cast comprising Abhishek Banerjee, Srishti Shrivastava, Rohitashv Gour, Gopal Dutt, Aditya Raj Sen and others. With Hisaab, Vipul Shah returns to the bank heist genre 25 years after delivering the much-loved Aankhen (2002), which starred Amitabh Bachchan, Akshay Kumar, Arjun Rampal, Paresh Rawal and Sushmita Sen. In an interview with Mid-Day in February this year, Vipul Shah revealed that Hisaab is a film about a bank robbery “with a twist”.
